$schema_note: Machine-readable companion to voice-cross-dialect-mapping.md. Consumed by the voice cross-parity conformance leg and the #14-B Gemini codec. Fixture paths are relative to testing/voice-conformance/fixtures/.

openai.name: OpenAI Realtime API
openai.shape_note: Primary fixtures use the gpt-4o-realtime-preview flat session shape (the field set enumerated by the task). openai/session.update.ga_nested.json captures the newer gpt-realtime GA shape where these nest under session.audio.{input,output} and audio events are renamed response.output_audio.*.

gemini.name: Gemini Live API (BidiGenerateContent)
gemini.envelope: tagged-union: top-level single key names the message type

audio_bridge.openai_pcm16: raw 16-bit LE PCM, 24000 Hz for model output / 24000 Hz input default (rate implied by session, not tagged per-frame)
audio_bridge.gemini_input: audio/pcm;rate=16000 (raw 16-bit LE PCM, 16 kHz), rate tagged in mimeType
audio_bridge.gemini_output: audio/pcm;rate=24000 (raw 16-bit LE PCM, 24 kHz), rate tagged in mimeType
audio_bridge.transform: Both carry base64 raw PCM. Bridge must (a) resample 24kHz(OpenAI out)/model-rate to Gemini's tagged rates, (b) synthesize/parse the mimeType rate parameter Gemini requires but OpenAI omits, (c) transcode g711_ulaw/alaw <-> linear pcm16 since Gemini has no g711 mode (see asymmetry: openai_g711).

concepts.transform: instructions<->systemInstruction.parts[].text; voice<->prebuiltVoiceConfig.voiceName (name maps differ: alloy/verse/marin vs Puck/Charon/Kore); modalities array (OpenAI allows [audio,text]) -> responseModalities (Gemini permits exactly ONE of AUDIO|TEXT -> drop text, warn); tools[].{name,description,parameters} <-> functionDeclarations[] with JSON-Schema type casing lowercased<->UPPERCASED.
OpenAI echoes the fully-resolved session; Gemini sends an empty setupComplete ack. Bridge fabricates the missing side (synthesize a resolved-session view for Gemini, or an empty ack for OpenAI).
content[].input_text.text <-> turns[].parts[].text; role user<->user. OpenAI item is standalone (no turn flag); Gemini needs turnComplete to close the turn.
audio(base64) <-> realtimeInput.audio.data; OpenAI carries no per-frame format (session-wide) so bridge must inject/strip audio.mimeType with the rate parameter. See audio_bridge.
Explicit commit <-> audioStreamEnd. Under server/automatic VAD both are usually implicit; the bridge emits the counterpart only when the peer works in manual mode.

delta(base64) <-> modelTurn.parts[].inlineData.data. OpenAI streams flat deltas keyed by response_id/item_id; Gemini wraps each chunk in a modelTurn Content. Bridge must group/ungroup and inject/strip the mimeType rate.

response.audio.done -> per-modality end; response.done(status=completed) -> turnComplete. Gemini splits generationComplete (model finished generating) from turnComplete (turn yielded); OpenAI has no generationComplete equivalent -> collapse, warn.

fields: (no explicit per-event server signal; automaticActivityDetection handles internally; interrupted implies barge-in)

concepts.transform: OpenAI emits explicit speech_started/stopped with ms offsets; Gemini's automatic activity detection is internal and surfaces only serverContent.interrupted on barge-in. speech_started/stopped -> DROP toward Gemini (warn); Gemini has no ms offsets to reconstruct them. See asymmetry: openai_speech_boundary.

correlation id: OpenAI call_id <-> Gemini functionCalls[].id. arguments: OpenAI streams a JSON STRING via .delta then .done -> Gemini delivers a parsed args OBJECT in one message. Bridge must accumulate deltas + JSON.parse toward Gemini, and stringify + optionally chunk toward OpenAI.

call_id <-> functionResponses[].id (same value as the originating call). output STRING <-> response OBJECT (parse/stringify). Gemini requires name on the response; OpenAI does not carry it -> bridge must remember name from the originating call.

OpenAI barge-in is TWO client actions (truncate the played item at an exact audio_end_ms + cancel the response) plus can be server-driven; Gemini surfaces a single server-side interrupted=true with NO ms offset. Bridge: interrupted -> synthesize response.cancel (and a best-effort truncate without precise ms, warn on lost precision); truncate.audio_end_ms -> DROP toward Gemini (no field). See asymmetry: openai_truncate_precision.

transcript <-> inputTranscription.text. Enabled via session.input_audio_transcription <-> setup.inputAudioTranscription. (OpenAI standalone fixture is in the transcript golden; the concept is exercised there.)

OpenAI carries the assistant transcript inside the audio content item (response.done / response.audio_transcript.*); Gemini streams a dedicated outputTranscription.text. Bridge relocates the text between the content item and the standalone message.

input_tokens<->promptTokenCount; output_tokens<->responseTokenCount; total_tokens<->totalTokenCount. Modality split: OpenAI *_token_details.{text,audio}_tokens <-> Gemini *TokensDetails[] array of {modality,tokenCount}. OpenAI attaches usage to response.done; Gemini sends a separate usageMetadata message.

asymmetry.handling: drop+warn: Gemini has no g711 mode; bridge must transcode g711<->pcm16 or refuse the telephony leg.
drop+warn: Gemini only has automaticActivityDetection sensitivity levels; eagerness has no direct equivalent -> map to nearest sensitivity, warn.
drop+warn: Gemini interrupted carries no offset; ms precision is lost bridging toward Gemini.

asymmetry.concept: explicit server VAD speech_started/speech_stopped events with ms
asymmetry.handling: drop+warn: Gemini keeps activity detection internal; no per-event boundary to map.
drop: Gemini has no explicit clear; uncommitted audio handled by activity detection.
drop+warn: Gemini has no per-turn config override; only setup-time config. Non-default overrides are dropped.
drop+warn: Gemini reports errors via WebSocket close codes, not a structured in-band error message; bridge maps close-reason<->error best-effort.
drop: Gemini messages carry no client correlation id.
synthesize: OpenAI has no gate; bridge must hold client sends until an equivalent ready state or emit an implicit ack.

asymmetry.concept: toolCallCancellation (model retracts a pending tool call)
asymmetry.handling: drop+warn: OpenAI has no server-driven tool-call cancellation; host must be told to abandon the call out of band.
collapse: OpenAI has a single response.done; the generationComplete/turnComplete distinction is flattened.
drop+warn: OpenAI has no advance-disconnect warning; surface as a host-side event only.
map-to-commit: bridges to input_audio_buffer.commit only under manual VAD.
